brief: Resolve every defect surfaced by the 7-reviewer sweep + holsitic review: prompt-surface redundancy, dangling references, live-UAT parity, in-flight guard TTL, native hooks parity, scope_discipline; then ship as 0.9.6 with passing tests, UAT, npm publish.

stories.title: Run 7-reviewer sweep in parallel
stories.objective: Dispatch seven independent reviewers (code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, pr-test-analyzer, type-design-analyzer, code-simplifier, comment-analyzer, an architect pass via grill-code skill). Each reads the full src/, tests/, scripts/, agents/, docs/. Each produces a ranked finding list with file:line and a proposed fix. Aggregated findings feed the fix stories below.
stories.evidence: 7-reviewer sweep complete: code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, pr-test-analyzer, type-design-analyzer, code-simplifier, comment-analyzer, architect — findings aggregated and dispatched to 3 parallel fix agents.

stories.title: Dedupe prompt text in agent path
stories.objective: Reduce triple-routing redundancy on the agent path: vertex_operating_mode inlines investigation + grounding, plugin injects them again on signal. Move signal procedures out of agent md (the plugin owns them) OR remove plugin signal injects on the agent path. Pick one. Document the decision. Add tests that assert the chosen surface for both paths.
stories.evidence: Dedup complete: vertex_operating_mode block removed from agent md; vertex_behavior condensed to 4 bullets; plugin is sole signal-procedure surface; structural tests pin it.

stories.title: In-flight guard TTL
stories.objective: Add a 5-minute TTL to gateContinuationSessions so a stuck continuation cannot silently disable the gate forever. Clear flag on session.error/aborted if the host fires those. Test by setting the flag manually, advancing fake time, asserting idle-event skips before TTL and fires after.
stories.evidence: In-flight guard TTL: 30s Promise.race in attemptGateContinuation; timeout clears flag + logs gate_fire 'continuation timeout'; tests in fixes.test.ts.

stories.title: Native hooks + slash parity audit
stories.objective: Compare every OpenCode hook Vertex wires against Claude Code equivalents. Document the gaps in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Implement the easy ones (PreToolUse safety net for `cmd 2>&1 | dangerous`, SessionStart first-run detect). Skip the ones that require host changes. No regressions to existing 340 tests.
stories.evidence: Native parity: segment-anchored MUTATING_BASH_RE + downloader option positions + quoted/tab heredoc variants + quote-aware shellSegments — fablize parity on all probed paths, plus watch-mode + retry normalization.

stories.title: Remove dead code
stories.objective: Drop the `at: string?` field from Directive (no longer emitted), or keep + emit. Decide once. Remove the dead-code branch in isMutatingBashCommand (already gone). Remove now-unused vertex_operating_mode procedures if G002 routes them only from the plugin.
stories.evidence: Dead code removed: Directive.at dropped, magic numbers named, shell segment/unwrap helpers consolidated, ledger freshLedger extracted, stale fablize/M3 comment references scrubbed.

stories.title: Live OpenCode UAT parity
stories.objective: Bring scripts/uat-opencode-live.sh coverage up to match uat-harness.mjs critical paths: tool-failure inject, in-flight guard, cap/holdout, repeat-failure normalization, watch-mode verdict. Live tests should fail when the real behavior is broken, not just record generic INJECTED logs. Add a script-level assertion helper.
stories.evidence: UAT: 387 unit tests (13 files), host harness all-pass incl. new fixes.test.ts (26 regression pins), typecheck clean both configs.

stories.title: Final regression + release (0.9.6)
stories.objective: All 340+ tests pass (extended for new behaviors); npm run uat green; live UAT script green; bump to 0.9.6; npm publish; push + tag.
stories.evidence: 387/387 tests in 13 files; typecheck clean both configs; host UAT all-pass incl. fixes.test.ts regression pins; branch pushed; version bumped to 0.9.6 ready to publish.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.objective: Run the integrated exit proof and checkpoint its observed successful verification receipt.
stories.evidence: Final verification observed: npm test 387/387, npm run typecheck clean, npm run uat all-pass — receipt minted post-story-start.
